limits: Mycelium sees lookups, connection attempts and byte totals, not contents. Passwords, messages and the insides of individual packets never pass through it.
help: I keep field notes on the apps you watch: which domains they look up, which companies they reach, what was blocked, and how much data moved.
help_examples: Ask, for example, what an app did today, which companies turned up this week, what happened last night, or what was blocked.
out_of_scope: That lies outside what I can observe. I only speak about lookups, trackers, blocks and data use recorded on this device.
no_data: I have no record of that. I only speak about what this phone has seen.
not_watched: {label} is not being watched, so I hold no lookups for it.
not_watched_bytes: The system counted {amount} {unit} moved by it {period}.
not_watched_offer: Start watching {label} and I will begin taking notes.
watch_unknown: I could not find that app among the ones installed here.
unwatch_not_watched: {label} is not being watched at the moment.
watch_confirm: Watching {label} needs your confirmation. Tap to begin.
unwatch_confirm: Stop watching {label}? Tap to confirm; its past notes are kept.
summary_trackers: {tracker_hits} of those lookups went to {companies} tracker companies; {top_company} was the most frequent, with {top_hits}.
Tracker companies took {tracker_hits} of them, spread over {companies} companies; {top_company} led with {top_hits}.
summary_no_trackers: No tracker companies turned up for {species} {period}.
summary_blocked: {blocked} of its lookups were turned away by your rules.
summary_background: {bg} happened while {species} sat in the background.
top_apps_lead: The most active creature {period} was {species}, with {value} {unit}.
companies_lead: {company} turned up most often {period}: {hits} lookups, from {apps} of the watched apps.
companies_app_lead: {company} was the most frequent contact of {species} {period}, with {hits} lookups.
when_app: {species} contacted {target} {hits} times {period}, first at {first_time} and last at {last_time}.
recent_count: {n} events were recorded {period}; the latest follow.
recent_dns_tracker: At {time}, {species} looked up {domain}, which belongs to {company}.
recent_dns_blocked: At {time}, {species} asked for {domain} and was turned away.
recent_tripwire: At {time}, {species} knocked on the tripwire at port {port}.
night_quiet: The garden was quiet between 00:00 and 06:00 on {date}.
night_total: Between 00:00 and 06:00 on {date}, the watched apps made {lookups} lookups, {bg} of them in the background.
night_app: {species} accounted for {lookups} background lookups, {tracker_hits} of them to trackers.
compare_all: The watched apps made {n2} lookups {period2}, against {n1} {period1}.
